TD Studios luxury site: Next.js 15.5.4 App Router, React 18, strict TypeScript, pnpm 10.15.1, Supabase/PostgreSQL, Tailwind 3.4.17, shadcn/ui New York/RSC, Radix UI, Geist fonts, Lucide icons. Synced v0.app → GitHub → Vercel; project: [v0.app/chat/projects/MgSVoHLfRb7](https://v0.app/chat/projects/MgSVoHLfRb7).

## Structure and routes
`app/` contains pages and `api/`; `components/` contains reusable UI; `lib/` contains utilities; `public/` contains assets; `styles/` contains CSS; `tests/` contains tests. `app/globals.css` holds design tokens and mobile optimizations; `app/layout.tsx` includes StickyHeader, Footer, analytics, and iOS Safari viewport fixes. `app/page.tsx` is the homepage.

Routes: `/`, `/work`, `/web`, `/dev`, `/social`, `/design`, `/process`, `/resources`, `/faq`, `/contact`, `/book`, `/support`, `/legal`, `/[client]/signin`, `/clients/[client]`. `/pricing` merged into `/faq`; `/services` split into `/web`, `/dev`, `/social`, `/design`. See [ROUTES.md](./ROUTES.md). Primary nav: WORK · WEB · DEV · SOCIAL · DESIGN · PROCESS · RESOURCES · FAQ · CONTACT. Footer: Support · Legal · Book. Pages include canonical, OpenGraph, Twitter Card, and JSON-LD metadata.

API: `api/contact/` handles POST contact submissions via Resend; `api/chatkit/session/` handles POST OpenAI ChatKit sessions; `api/intake/` handles POST lead qualification and Supabase storage. Client portals use `jose` JWT sessions and client-specific passcodes; `/clients/[client]` requires a valid JWT.

Key components: `sticky-header.tsx`, `nav.tsx`, `footer.tsx`, `glass-card.tsx`, `frosted-button.tsx`, `page-title.tsx`, `section.tsx`, `json-ld.tsx`, `calendly-embed.tsx`, `logo.tsx`, `analytics-provider.tsx`, `ab-test-wrapper.tsx`, `theme-provider.tsx`, `ui/`. Utilities: `lib/utils.ts`, `lib/analytics.ts`, `lib/ab-testing.ts`.

## Environment variables
Create `.env.local` in project root using `.env.local.example`:
`RESEND_API_KEY`, `CONTACT_TO_EMAIL`, `OPENAI_API_KEY`, `SUPABASE_URL`, `SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`, `NEXT_PUBLIC_BUILD_TIME` (auto-injected), `JWT_SECRET` (minimum 32 characters), `CLIENT_{CLIENTSLUG}_PASSCODE` (e.g., `CLIENT_THEBODYBOUTIQUE_PASSCODE`).

## Commands
pnpm dev            # Start development server (Next.js dev mode on port 3000)
pnpm serve          # Start production server on port 3000 (after building)
pnpm build          # Build for production using Next.js
pnpm lint           # Run Next.js linting with ESLint
pnpm typecheck      # Run TypeScript type checking without emitting files
pnpm ci:verify      # Run full CI verification (lint + typecheck + test)
pnpm report:types   # Generate type error report using custom script
pnpm scan:secrets   # Scan entire codebase for potential secrets using secretlint
pnpm scan:secrets:staged  # Scan only staged git files for secrets (used by pre-commit hook)
pnpm test           # Run unit tests with Vitest (single run)
pnpm test:watch     # Run Vitest in watch mode for development
pnpm test:jest      # Run Jest tests (if applicable)
npx playwright test # Run Playwright end-to-end tests
npx playwright test --ui # Run tests with UI mode for debugging
npx playwright test tests/mobile-layout.spec.ts # Run specific test file
pnpm lh:routes      # Run Lighthouse audits on routes using custom script

`pnpm test` - Run all unit tests once
`pnpm test:watch` - Watch mode for development
`pnpm ci:verify` - Run lint + typecheck + test for CI

## Tests, configuration, and design
Vitest: `vitest.config.ts`, jsdom, `tests/setup.ts`, `tests/*.spec.ts?(x)`, `@/` alias, globals, JSX automatic transform, `passWithNoTests: false`; excludes `**/mobile-layout.spec.ts`, `**/playwright/**`. Playwright has default configuration; mobile tests cover hero alignment, parallax, touch targets, and viewport/text sizing; screenshots in `tests/screenshots/`.

TypeScript targets ES2017 with strict mode, `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`, `noImplicitReturns`, `noFallthroughCasesInSwitch`, isolated modules, Next.js plugin, and `@/*` mapped to project root. ESLint and TypeScript build errors are ignored during builds for deployment/v0.app compatibility. Image domains: `i.imgur.com`, `via.placeholder.com`, `cdn.platform.openai.com`, `tdstudiosny.com`; formats: AVIF/WebP. Permanent 301 redirect: www.tdstudiosny.com → tdstudiosny.com.

Visual system: mobile-first dark theme, black `oklch(0.145 0 0)` background, white text, OKLCH CSS variables, neutral glass cards with backdrop blur, 0.625rem default radius, accessible focus/hover states, responsive spacing, and light/dark support. Analytics tracks page views, clicks, forms, downloads, bookings, scroll depth, time on page, and CTA performance. A/B testing supports variants, traffic allocation, and conversion tracking.

## Workflow and security
**Primary Development**: Use v0.app interface for major changes
**Manual Edits**: Consider sync implications when making direct code changes
**CI Pipeline**: Use `pnpm ci:verify` for comprehensive validation before commits
**Branch Protection**: Feature branch workflow enforced - all changes to main must go through PRs

Husky hooks install via postinstall. Pre-commit scans staged files with secretlint; pre-push blocks direct pushes to main and scans secrets outside CI. Relevant hook commands:
if ! git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=ACM | xargs -I{} -r secretlint "{}"; then
echo "🚫 Secretlint found potential secrets in staged files."
branch="$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD)"
[ "$branch" = "main" ] && { echo "🚫 Direct pushes to main are blocked. Use feature branch + PR."; exit 1; }
if [ -z "$CI" ]; then
pnpm -s scan:secrets >/dev/null || { echo "🚫 Pre-push secret scan failed."; exit 1; }

secretlint uses `<REDACTED_USER>/secretlint-rule-preset-recommend`. Use strict interfaces and component prop types, `"use client"` for interactive components, PascalCase component names, kebab-case files, semantic HTML, ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, lazy loading, Tailwind utilities, and CVA variants.

Architecture and infrastructure reference: [docs/architecture-map.json](./docs/architecture-map.json), last updated 2025-10-10; includes deployment integrations, DNS/TLS/HTTP findings, and infrastructure action items.
